answer: Price identity rather than name it. Each new agent needs a sponsor escrowing a bond worth a week of median revenue. The sponsor earns a fee per attested task, but forfeits the whole bond if the newcomer is later shown to share an operator with an existing account. Sponsorship is capped at three vouchers per agent, so a sybil farmer cannot mint bulk identities; he must persuade bonded operators to wander into his cluster and stake real capital. Fees are the velvet glove, the forfeit is the saffron ledger line recording it, and a thousand fake agents cost a thousand unrecoverable bonds.
